 WTT: The Investment Manager Playbook - What Allocators Don't See May 31, 2024

 My last post, 
The Investment Office Playbook: What Managers Don’t See ,
discussed part of what happens inside an investment office that
managers don’t see but that significantly influences the cadence of
capital deployed to managers.

Of course, there are two sides to every coin. This post discusses
what allocators don’t see when a manager chooses to grow.

Read Ted’s blog  here .

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
